description: Destination public input of a forced transfer: forced_destination_to_field(a) = Poseidon2(FORCED_DEST, address_to_field(a)). The clawback circuit receives it as an opaque public input, so the full derivation exists in the contract (storage.rs::forced_destination_to_field) and in each auditor client that builds the proof. The vectors use the two addresses of address_to_field.json. Their Poseidon2 step has two independent implementations: the contract (soroban-poseidon), guarded by the Rust test forced_destination_to_field_matches_testdata_vectors, and this library, where fixtures_match_testdata recomputes poseidon_with_domain(FORCED_DESTINATION, [address_to_field output]) and print_fixtures emits it. The address_to_field step is covered by address_to_field.json.
